title: Invite a teacher to your school

steps.say: The **Invite teachers** card below the list holds one standing link that turns anyone who opens it into a teacher of your school.
It is the same link every time, so you can hand it to a whole staff room at once. **Copy invite link**, then send it however you reach your staff — Teams, WhatsApp, printed on a slip.

They open it, sign in once, and appear in your list as a teacher. If you are standing in front of them instead, **Show code instead** gives you a short code to read out, and they type it in at saysomethingin.com/redeem.
steps.terminal: That's your staff room in — one link, shared as many times as you like. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
